stateNote: Heat a medium-sized non-stick skillet over medium heat. Using a small amount of canola oil—just enough to coat the cooking surface—sauté the tofu, browning it to a golden color. Between the marinade and heat, it will achieve a medium-brown, but won't achieve the deep brown of ground beef or commercial ground beef substitute.
